RestServiceDefinition.SqlExecute: with CTE AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN T."@odata.type" = '#microsoft.graph.user' THEN T.userPrincipalName WHEN T."@odata.type" = '#microsoft.graph.servicePrincipal' THEN T.appDisplayName WHEN T."@odata.type" = '#microsoft.graph.group' THEN T.displayName ELSE NULL END AS UserName, M.roleName AS RoleName FROM UserRolesTemp T LEFT JOIN Members M ON M.principalId = T.id ) select Distinct * from CTE
